property_summary: For any addresses owner and logger and any boolean status, if the contract owner calls setApprovedLogger(logger, status) then approvedLoggers(logger) equals status afterwards; the mutant that stores !_status will make approvedLoggers(logger) != status for some inputs (when called by the owner).
change_summary: Change assignment to set the logger status to the negation of the provided _status (invert stored value).
